CA.rationale: No attention/allocation relation to content is stated.

COD.rationale: Content (red positions), its organization (coordinate listing) and a separate origin/status field are all explicitly reported for the same referent/time.

A.rationale: No explicit attention/allocation or processing condition linked to content presentation/access is stated.

C.rationale: The report explicitly identifies contents (color labels) with their positional attributes for named referents.

D.rationale: Origins/status fields are provided separately from the identified content/positions, distinguishing identity from status/source.

O.rationale: The report specifies how content is represented as coordinate sets for current and conditional candidate referents (organized spatial pattern).
